purpose: Qualify full-DD terminal response on known M65/M74 intervention before M80 attribution.
supersedes_proposed_action_only: M78 conditional local-support A/B is not executed; user authorized post-M78 research plan instead.

definitions.reference: Frozen matched-ni/no-BGN M65 and electron-only M74 gate endpoints
definitions.parameter: alpha from legacy electron Poisson volume (0) to Si barycentric (1)
definitions.source: F_alpha=F_candidate(u)-F_baseline(u) at each endpoint; coordinates and all other settings identical
definitions.current: Same signed drain current A/um as frozen curve; check both residual functional and production extractor
definitions.prediction: -lambda.T F_alpha plus explicit g_alpha; compare dI/(I ln10) at both endpoints against log10|I1/I0|
definitions.finite_difference: Centered +/- directions, max physical component 1e-5 and 5e-6 V; response plus deterministic psi/phin/phip directions with contact exclusion
definitions.signal: Current directional derivative above max(1e-20 A/um, 1e-12*full_gradient_norm); other rows reported but not qualified
definitions.failure: No M80 on failed identity/Jacobian/duality gates. Finite-amplitude failure requires separately frozen small-amplitude calibration. Never relax thresholds retrospectively.
